label: Bible Study
prompt: Jesus Christ the same _____, and to day, and for ever.
verse: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
note: The unchanging Christ — and yes, 'to day' is two words in the KJV, charmingly.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in _____, but shall have the light of life.
verse: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
note: Followers don't get a map; they get a light that walks in front of them.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I _____, I perish.
verse: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
note: Esther's resolve before the unsummoned walk to the throne room: 'if I perish, I perish.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: So then because thou art _____, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
verse: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
note: Laodicea's tepid water made the Lord gag — he'd rather have you hot or cold than room temperature.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a _____ of them that diligently seek him.
verse: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
note: Faith believes two things, says Hebrews: that God is, and that he is a 'rewarder' of diligent seekers.
